title: cordylanthus rigidus subsp. involutus
intro: Cordylanthus rigidus subsp. involutus, commonly known as the Purple Sage or Purple Bird's-eye Gilia, is a perennial plant that belongs to the plantain family (Plantaginaceae). This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which help to alleviate symptoms of colds, fever, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Cordylanthus rigidus subsp. involutus include expectorant, antitussive, and anti-inflammatory effects, making it a valuable remedy for respiratory conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
